scope: Native Claude Messages full-history import on a single-target route only. Later system entries, cross-provider translation, durable local Responses IDs, Kimi live inference excluded.

findings.resolution: Cold imports now reserve a provenance entry in the existing bounded shared cache before dispatch. Provenance stores owner and conversation. Other overlapping imports reject before upstream contact. Staged commit revalidates exclusive reservation identity synchronously with atomic batch publication. Preparation failures, signal abort, consumer cancellation and failed publication release only their own pending entries; successful commits replace pending entries with permanent scoped provenance.
findings.behavior: An overlapping cold import of an already pending signature is rejected, including the same scope, until the first attempt commits or releases. After successful commit only exact replay in the recorded owner/conversation is accepted.

findings.status: implemented; in-memory isolation checks pass; HTTP behavior remains blocked
findings.resolution: Every configured legacy/API/subscription/refresh endpoint and both routed profiles use the fixture origin. Native auth/config paths point to absent files/directories inside an owned temporary directory. All profiles use fabricated env credentials. A fail-closed exact-URL/redirect allowlist wraps routed fetch. HTTP origins reject every path except the expected native Messages path, and both stream-mode gates now deliberately exercise route-miss passthrough against that local rejection path.
findings.runtimeLimit: No listener or HTTP gate was rerun. The local route-miss HTTP assertions remain unexecuted.
